scope: Original two-QVI-neuron diagnostic; preserve receiver 49 outputs while moving source boundary -0.01. Existing readout coefficients only; no new features, state, reset laws, labels or task objective.
support_qualification: Projection values already occur in original graph but were frozen in the prior two-coordinate protocol. This explicitly enlarged edit mask is compared to identical-support BP; it does not invalidate the old two-coordinate lower bound.

validation.claim: Unseen continuous-valued initial conditions, finite deterministic validation; not a proof over every real initial state and not fresh task sources.

objectives.native: Analytic cost inversion enforces target boundary; minimize mean squared receiver-start error on all fit anchors over the three readout coordinates within the box. Enumerate all 27 active/free patterns with deterministic small least squares.
objectives.bp_conditional: Same analytic cost and exactly same three-coordinate bounded least-squares problem; gradients through actual Torch FP64 readout.
objectives.bp_joint: Joint four-coordinate bounded optimization of squared boundary discrepancy plus mean squared receiver-start discrepancy, all from identical original initialization.
objectives.const_minimax: Analytic cost and minimax constant offset over fit anchors, original two-coordinate mask.
objectives.const_original: Original single-anchor compensation at 0.72, original two-coordinate mask.

bp_solver.name: SciPy L-BFGS-B with Torch FP64 exact first derivatives
bp_solver.initialization: original parameters; conditional cost already fixed analytically
bp_solver.bounds: per-coordinate original +/-0.1; source cost also strictly positive

infeasibility_certificate: For recorded FP64 A,r and box L, any witness u gives inf_delta ||A delta-r||inf >= |u^T r|-L||A^T u||1. Rust outward-rounded arithmetic reports a conservative lower bound. This certifies the recorded finite linear problem, not continuum physical arithmetic.
acceptance: Boundary, parameter box, every fit anchor and all 321 unseen initial states must pass unchanged 1e-7 receiver-output gate. Native plan fit gate is separate. No new tolerance or validation selection after results.
rollback: Write diagnostic candidate in isolated checkpoint store, reopen and verify entire fixed validation. Commit locally only if every gate passes; otherwise restore original bytes and record pre/post SHA256 equality. No production publication or trading authority.
comparison: All arms include common baseline/target preparation, solve time, independent validation time and process overhead. One warm solver call then three timed alternating repeats; no repeated end-to-end data selection. Report CPU time, peak RSS, gradient calls and forward calls. Torch one CPU thread; no GPU or remote training.
budget: At most 5 anchor sets x 2 BP arms x 4 (warm+timed) solves x solver configured maxfun 60; record any line-search overrun. No hyperparameter search; numerical bug fixes get separate attempt records.
reporting: Keep every arm, all fit/validation errors, failures, solver termination, source/output hashes. Distinguish local improvement, fit feasibility, finite validation and any unclosed task/production claim.
